rules: 697 FH5 garage cars are classified from the uploaded phone backup, not the older 697 spreadsheet snapshot.
NORMAL / FORZA EDITION / DRIFT / RACE / OFF-ROAD-BUGGY
Every car is assigned exactly one ecosystem before manufacturer, era, class or theme filters are applied.
Normal championships exclude every specialist car.
FE never crosses into normal pools. Road FE and Off-Road FE are split so one FE setup is not asked to do both jobs.
Four-zone Festival baseline; Race Off gives each pairing one random zone shared by both cars. Shuffle-bag/no-repeat philosophy.
Race ecosystem uses a curated vehicle list. Track Toys / Extreme Track Toys are NOT blindly treated as race cars.
Includes rally categories plus buggies, UTVs, dedicated off-roaders, trucks and Pickups & 4x4. Never routed to road finales such as The Colossus.
24 result entries max per campaign slot
Small fields combine rounds; 13–24 cars use one round per visit; 25+ use 8-car Groups with two tracks per group.
The old 60-result six-round slog is gone. Each Modern Rally visit is 20 results.
Universal cap preserves the accepted circuit-relief rule; no return of 10-pairing circuit death marches.
One run each; fastest wins. Batches cap at 24 cars. Drag is the deliberate temporary setup exception.
Festival/Rally/Hot Wheels/Drift random pools should avoid repeats until their pool is exhausted, then refill.
FE, Drift, Race, Off-Road and Normal all-car brackets bank their final stages into Finals Week.
Do not reset the current live Evil Campaign until this replacement has been inspected and then embedded into the app.
setupGuide: NORMAL / ROAD
Sport or Semi-Slick; widen where PI allows
Race springs/dampers + Race ARBs; brakes if needed
Race diff; Sport/Race gearbox; keep original drivetrain
Handling first; sensible weight reduction; power last
Road/Street only
RACE
Keep factory race hardware first; slicks where appropriate
Keep factory race suspension/aero or use Race kit
Race diff/gearbox as useful; preserve intended drivetrain
Tune before power; weight only if useful
Dedicated road-race events
OFF-ROAD / BUGGY
Offroad Race for XC/buggy; Rally tyres for rally cars
Rally/Offroad suspension + tunable ARBs
Suitable Rally/Offroad diff; Race gearbox, shorter gearing
Grip/travel/stability first
Dirt/XC/Rally Adventure only
DRIFT
Drift tyres
Drift suspension + tunable ARBs
Drift diff + Race gearbox; keep RWD unless designed otherwise
Enough power to hold angle; control first
Random Drift Zones; score higher wins
FORZA EDITION
Preserve useful FE factory hardware first
Only change if the FE role needs it
Tunable gearbox/diff as appropriate; no universal swap
Keep FE identity; avoid rebuild-for-the-sake-of-it
FE-only; Road FE or Off-Road FE
DRAG TEMP
Drag tyres
Drag suspension
